text_block_list.text:
During the Nippon Derby,
we rushed there through a typhoon.
I fully intended to overcome this as well.

"However, the next obstacle—
hit us from a completely unexpected direction."
choice_data_list: Huh, an issue with your license?!

text_block_list.name: URA Administrative Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes... A critical defect was found
in your Trainer registration documents...

text_block_list.name: URA Administrative Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"We discussed it, but... until verification is complete,
your movements will be restricted. For instance, you won't be
allowed into the backstage areas at racecourses."
"If we can't get into the backyard—"

I can't provide pre-race care for Neo Universe.
If that causes her to fall short of her full potential...

This will become an unbearable regret.
Why did something like this have to happen...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer—will be blocked by karma.
Greater than the Japanese Derby. An ocean stands in the way.
Causality... Is this what Neo Universe was talking about?

The sea of division—taking a different shape,
is now right before our very eyes...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I tried negotiating with them,
but they said it's simply impossible this time...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Could you perhaps handle it using only the accessible areas?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you can just bear with it this once, it'll be fine
from next time onward. I'm sure it can be solved...
choice_data_list: I can't drink! The Kikuka Sho only comes once...

text_block_list.name: URA Administrative Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down.
If you try to force your way in...

text_block_list.name: URA Administrative Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, you won't be able to escape
having your Trainer license suspended, you know?

text_block_list.name: URA Administrative Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's the Classic Triple Crown,
do you really intend to ruin your entire future
just to accompany someone a single time?

"Just once. That might be one way to look at it.
However..."

"It might not just be a one-time thing.
Neo Universe said..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe assumes
"The Great Dividing."

This is a major turning point.
In other words—
Will we move forward together with Neo Universe, or will we part ways? Perhaps this is that turning point.
—The boundary line of destiny. Though invisible to me, Neo Universe insists she can see it.

"The rules" or "dying together."
If I have to choose between them—
(Dadadada, bang!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san...
Um... please take good care of me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Is... something wrong? You seem a bit down...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe... cannot see the future.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The future—cannot be seen.
All Neo Universe can see...
is the 'starlight.' But—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That starlight—was emitted hundreds of millions of years ago.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if that star is still there even now.
Maybe it's a "FOBN"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
So... this is fine.
Even if they couldn't come...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You are not "you."
Or rather—you are no longer "you."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe will try going forward.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
At the very least... for Rob Roy's sake...
If no one else, then Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Eh!?

I don't have time to care about the eyes around me.
I just shout with all my might to make my presence known.
"—Just once. However, if one takes that single time lightly, destiny will crack, and the stars will shatter."

The bonds we've shared have taught me
that there are things more important than rules.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Trai...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: So after all... "you" are...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san...! Your Trainer
was running late, weren't they...? That's why...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we're all good now, right?
Let's give our Kikuka Sho everything we've got!”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

A rematch with Zenno Rob Roy.
To compete against a hero candidate who has grown even stronger—

I had to remain steadfast as well.
We were prepared to become a shooting star together.
